question: Which of the following vices consists of a handle and a small collet chuck at one end?
solution:
The correct answer is __Pin vice**(Option 4)**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Pin vice__ is a small tool used for holding objects like wires, rods, or small drills.
 
• It consists of a handle and a small collet chuck at one end for gripping objects securely.
 
• Commonly used in jewelry making, watchmaking, and model crafting.
 
• It allows for precise control when working on delicate tasks.
 
• The collet chuck can be adjusted to hold objects of varying sizes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Pipe vice:**

 
 
• Specialized vice used for holding pipes securely during cutting or threading.
 
• It uses a chain or jaw mechanism to grip pipes.
 
 
 
• **Toolmaker’s vice:**
 
 
• Precision vice often used in toolmaking and machining applications.
 
• Typically smaller and provides high accuracy.
 
 
 
• **Hand vice:**
 
 
• A small handheld vice used for gripping small objects firmly.
 
• Commonly used in filing, drilling, or sawing operations.
